note: ND Forest Service campground in Turtle Mountain State Forest on Lake Metigoshe, NE of Bottineau, with a picnic shelter, public boat ramp, fishing pier and access to an 8-mile paved trail. --Claude
summary: NDFS page + 2025 campground map read: 15 primitive sites (40-54) on a wooded loop, $20 first come first served, vault toilets and a water well, closed in winter. Groups written (count 16 -> 15). Not waterfront stands. Pin ok.
flags: INCLUSION: a designated campground (numbered sites 40-54 on a campground road loop, registration at the entrance), not a lawn allowance. No length limit is published; the sites are clearings under tree canopy that look adequate for a 23-ft rig on the imagery, but none is measured. HHS licenses it for 25 units.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The loop sits in woods ~200 m from the marsh on the north arm and ~300 m from the open lake at the day-use area and boat ramp to the south-east.
PIN: stored 48.97076,-100.36375 is on the campground road ~100 m east of the loop centre (~48.9708,-100.3651): ok.
PHONE: keep 701-228-3700 (NDFS office on the map; weekend patrol 701-871-7829).
INCLUSION EVIDENCE: the stored evidence says the sites are 'on open grass'; they are clearings under trees. Worth correcting if inclusion_evidence is rewritten.
